entities.summary: Andre Devell Spencer was an American professional basketball player. He was a 6-foot-6-inch (198 cm) 210 pounds (95 kg) forward and played collegiately for Bakersfield College, a junior college, and the Northern Arizona Lumberjacks. He played for three teams in the National Basketball Association (NBA), and for six seasons in the Israeli Basketball Premier League.
